source: Real Edge browser and Spring Boot/MyBatis/MySQL. Three browser requests use the configured real model. Repeated cancellation/adoption/staleness/mobile checks replay a recorded real candidate/report; one deliberate network failure. Synthetic survey only; prior account workspace restored.

checks.name: AI creation page performs a real single-question optimization and cancellation leaves every question intact
explicit adoption changes one question, then temporary save restores in a new browser context
real browser health review renders validated evidence and locates the matching question
review suggestions open optimization without applying or silently saving them
an optimization arriving after manual changes cannot overwrite them
a network failure preserves manual editing and save, with a visible retry message
the real editor adopts one question and its standard Save persists unchanged field identities
changes to editor configuration invalidate an already rendered candidate
an active published survey exposes read-only review and disables optimization
the review and comparison dialogs fit a 390px viewport in dark and light themes
